scope: The quest journey starts through the real selection button, then walks authored paths continuously using the real chapter-two controller, including three newly opened shortcuts and return visits. Healing and the final song use physical keyboard events. Save/Continue resets the scene from its own on-disk record. Separate scene reconstruction tests Continue for both chapters and a confirmed first-valley reset while retaining chapter two. No spatial relocation or direct quest mutation is used for gameplay progress. Fixed simulated steps are not a frame-rate or human wayfinding measurement.
